subject: history_social
passage: Mimar Sinan served as chief architect of the Ottoman Empire for about fifty years in the sixteenth century, and he is credited with designing more than three hundred buildings, including mosques, bridges, and public baths. He also trained a generation of younger architects in his workshop. Several of these students went on to have major careers of ______ own; one of them, Sedefkâr Mehmed Ağa, designed the Sultan Ahmed Mosque in Istanbul, completed in 1616.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The careers belong to "Several of these students," a plural group. A plural antecedent needs the plural possessive pronoun "their." The singular names nearby, Sinan and Sedefkâr Mehmed Ağa, are not the ones whose careers are being described.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "One's" refers to a general, unnamed person, but the antecedent is the specific plural "students."
explanation.B: Correct. "Their" is plural, matching "Several of these students."
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Its" is singular and refers to a thing, but the antecedent is the plural "students."
explanation.D: Incorrect. "His" is singular, but the careers belong to the plural "Several of these students."
